findings.title: Removing the whole document silently yields null, undocumented in README
findings.why: `removeAt` returns `{ root: null }` for an empty path, so `applyPatch(doc, [{op:"remove",path:""}])` returns `null`. RFC 6902 does not define this case. The README's `applyPatch` section does not mention it. task-003 records it only as an open point. A caller could mistake `null` for a real document.

findings.title: Plan documents committed as unfilled scaffolds
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) contain only the template placeholder comment. Their status is still `active` and the body is empty, although the work they describe is done.
